history.summary: Freehold 452sqft 1BR in D13 Potong Pasir at $899.9k / $1,991 PSF, with a solid ~4.9%/yr resale CAGR and excellent 360m MRT proximity. Sub-$900k entry and FH tenure are positives, but it is a niche shoebox in a boutique block with a very weak arena record.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only CAGR of 4.9%/yr is healthy and PSF ($1,991) is right at the URA median ($1,980), so it is fairly priced. But it is a 452sqft 1BR — the narrowest tenant/buyer pool — and the arena record is a dismal 55-251-9 (Elo 702), reflecting how shoeboxes underperform on liquidity and broad appeal. Good location and price hold it at Neutral rather than Avoid.
catalysts: 360m to Potong Pasir MRT (NE10) — strong commuter rental draw
